rationale: The hypothesis posits that subcellular mislocalization to the nucleolus or cytoplasm definitively differentiates DHX9 pathogenic variants from DHX30 pathogenic variants. While functional cellular assays demonstrate distinct subcellular mislocalization for specific DHX9 variant classes (nuclear localization signal [NLS] missense variants mislocalize to the cytoplasm, and CMT2-associated variants abnormally accumulate in the nucleolus), this localization assay does not definitively differentiate all DHX9 pathogenic variants. Crucially, Calame et al. (2023) established that the severe neurodevelopmental disorder (NDD)-associated variant p.Arg141Gln does not alter subcellular localization, instead acting via increased R-loops and DNA double-strand breaks. Furthermore, proteomic studies demonstrate that DHX9 is also recruited to stress granules alongside DHX30, undermining the absolute dichotomy in cellular compartmentalization between these two helicases.

evidence.text: In human cellular models and patient-derived fibroblasts, DHX9 NLS missense variants abnormally accumulated in the cytoplasm, whereas CMT2-associated variants caused aberrant nucleolar accumulation. However, the severe NDD-associated variant p.Arg141Gln did not alter DHX9 localization.

new_directions.question_text: Does high-throughput profiling of R-loop accumulation and DNA double-strand breaks reliably identify non-mislocalizing DHX9 variants (e.g., p.Arg141Gln) from DHX30-related NDD variants in patient fibroblasts?
new_directions.rationale: Because some severe NDD variants in DHX9 do not mislocalize, secondary cellular hallmarks like R-loop accumulation must be evaluated as complementary diagnostic criteria.

new_directions.question_text: Do DHX9 variants alter stress granule assembly, composition, or clearance kinetics compared to DHX30 pathogenic variants under arsenite or heat-shock stress?
new_directions.rationale: Single-cell proteomic data show DHX9 present in stress granules, suggesting stress-dependent phase separation assays could clarify whether stress granule dynamics are uniquely altered by DHX30 or also impacted by DHX9.
